note: Pre-registration of the phase 2 shadow signals (design v2, rigour charter rule 3 and section 8.3). Written before any test on our data. Shadow signals never influence a decision; the Signal Lab may admit one only if every gate passes. Higher value = expected to do better, unless expected_sign is -1. Horizon in trading days, forward return measured from the next open. Signal ids follow the engine contract (docs/contracts.md §2): intel.<name>. A signal dated D uses only information published by the end of the previous trading day (New York), so the value exists before the engine's decision for D.

gates.net_of_costs: expected gross alpha > turnover x 0.4% round trip

signals.hypothesis: Open-market purchases by several distinct insiders (Form 4, code P) in the last 90 days precede better returns; sales are mostly diversification and carry little information.
signals.definition: distinct insiders with code P in the last 90 calendar days minus 0.1 x distinct insiders with code S not under a 10b5-1 plan
signals.evidence_note: Strong in small caps, weak in mega-caps; purchases are rare in the S&P 100.
signals.data_note: SEC Form 4 via sec_edgar (insider_buy / insider_sell facts), PIT = dissemination time

signals.hypothesis: 8-K items that signal trouble (2.05 restructuring, 2.06 impairment, 4.02 non-reliance, 3.01 delisting notice, 1.05 cyber incident, 4.01 auditor change) in the last 10 days precede weaker returns.
signals.definition: count of those items disseminated in the last 10 calendar days

signals.hypothesis: A burst of Wikipedia attention is followed by a short-lived push and then a reversal; at a 5-day horizon from the next open the reversal dominates.
signals.definition: log(mean views of the last 3 published days / median of the previous 60 days)
signals.data_note: English Wikipedia daily pageviews (wikipedia), usable from D+1 12:00 UTC

signals.hypothesis: Higher year-on-year growth of the latest reported quarterly revenue precedes better returns (fundamental momentum).
signals.definition: latest reported revenue period (quarter or year-to-date) / the same period one year earlier - 1
signals.data_note: SEC XBRL companyconcept (sec_xbrl), latest vintage known at the decision time

signals.hypothesis: Cheaper companies (higher trailing earnings yield) do better over months (value).
signals.definition: trailing 12-month net income / (shares outstanding x last close)
signals.data_note: SEC XBRL net income (4 latest quarters known at T) and shares outstanding; close price from the phase 1 archive

signals.hypothesis: More cash-profitable companies (operating cash flow over assets) do better over months (quality).
signals.definition: trailing 12-month operating cash flow / latest total assets
signals.data_note: SEC XBRL operating cash flow (12 months) and total assets, latest vintages known at T

signals.hypothesis: Companies with more positive news tone (FinBERT on titles and press releases) in the last 3 days do better the next day; the effect is expected to be small and to decay as adoption grows.
signals.definition: mean of FinBERT (positive - negative) over linked documents published in the last 3 calendar days
signals.evidence_note: Next-day effect in the literature, strongest in small caps; doubtful net of costs with next-open execution.
signals.data_note: FinBERT readings of documents linked to the company (GDELT news, 8-K press releases, HN, FDA, Federal Register); usable once both the document and its reading are known

signals.hypothesis: The structured LLM reading (direction x magnitude of the expected effect on the company) summed over the last 5 days predicts the next 5 days.
signals.definition: sum of direction x magnitude for the ticker over readings of documents published in the last 5 calendar days
signals.data_note: Qwen3.5-4B readings of triaged documents (pinned model, stored outputs)

signals.hypothesis: Stocks that more members of Congress disclosed buying (minus selling) in the last 60 days do better over the next month, despite the disclosure delay.
signals.definition: distinct members buying minus distinct members selling, disclosed in the last 60 calendar days
signals.evidence_note: No edge for the average member after the STOCK Act; leaders possibly (small samples).
signals.data_note: House periodic transaction reports (house_ptr), PIT = next business day after filing

signals.hypothesis: The Daily World Brief's sector headwind/tailwind score (-2..+2), judged only from evidence dated <= T, predicts sector-relative returns over the next month.
signals.definition: the brief's score for the company's sector
signals.data_note: Daily World Brief (Qwen3.5-9B), stored once per day
